name: How to Plan for Flawless Cabinet Installation

step.name: Step 1
step.text: Planning for cabinet installation is all about precision and coordination. It’s not just about picking out beautiful cabinets; it’s making sure they fit perfectly and work seamlessly with the rest of your kitchen or bathroom. Here's a quick guide to a smooth process: First, confirm all cabinet dimensions, and seriously, double-check them against your space. Second, verify your walls are plumb and your floors are level – this prevents major headaches later. Third, pay close attention to appliance openings to ensure everything has its spot. Fourth, identify all utility locations for plumbing, electrical, and HVAC rough-ins. This is critical for avoiding conflicts. And finally, coordinate with other trades before installation; cabinets typically go in after rough-ins but before final finishes. Inaccurate measurements and poor sequencing are huge causes of delays. For custom or high-value installations in Berkeley, Alameda, or San Francisco, getting expert help is crucial. We can help ensure your cabinet installation is a success.
